covered_report_window: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Thursday, October 22, 2026 U.S. market close and before the Friday, October 23, 2026 U.S. market open.
market_context_summary: Risk-off session: the Nasdaq was down about 2% around midday as AI concerns returned, WTI approached $100 amid Middle East escalation, and the 10-year Treasury yield hovered near 5%; Friday flash PMIs and final Michigan sentiment can add macro volatility.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Gold production, AISC, free cash flow
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record cash generation and the gold-price backdrop support upside if production and costs preserve the margin windfall.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS is about $2.06; the market is focused on production, AISC and whether 2026 guidance holds.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong domain-base growth and renewals support another durable beat if new registrations convert into retained domains.
